name: Guadeloupe
prevalence_note: French national cyber-assistance guidance and Mondial Relay's own phishing alerts describe fake point-relais and courier SMS campaigns, which apply to Guadeloupe's relay-point network.
cross_border_note: Guadeloupe shares +590 with Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy and receives many mainland French (+33) calls; nearby Dominica (+1-767) and other NANP islands are also common origins.

scams.name: Faux SMS point relais
scams.name_en: Fake courier or point-relais SMS in Guadeloupe asking for a fee or code

red_flag_keywords.text: choisir un point relais via ce lien
régler une petite somme en ligne

scams.signals_en: An SMS says a parcel has arrived and asks the owner to pick a relay point or pay a tiny fee through a link that harvests card data.
scams.legit_en: Mondial Relay lists current phishing campaigns, and French cyber-assistance advises checking deliveries only on the carrier's site.
bait_tactics: Demander le nom exact du point relais à Pointe-à-Pitre ou aux Abymes
Dire qu'on passera au relais avec la pièce d'identité plutôt que de payer en ligne
